commit.message:
fix(tooltip): align exit transform origin with flipped placement

@heroui/tooltip returned the requested placement from useTooltip
instead of the actual placement chosen by useOverlayPosition, so the
exit animation originated from the wrong edge whenever the tooltip
flipped, for example on the guest filter button at xl width.

Apply the same axis check the popover implementation uses, so the
returned placement follows flips on both axes while alignment
placements such as top-start stay unchanged.

commit.message:
fix(design): upgrade framer-motion to fix chrome overlay flicker

Recent Chrome builds flicker once when HeroUI dropdown, tooltip, and
popover animations finish expanding. The app pinned framer-motion
12.17.2, which predates the Chrome change.

Upgrade framer-motion to 13.4.4, adapt the four eased transitions to the
v13 ease syntax, and return the dependency to the regular update path.
React 19.3.0, backdrop-filter, GPU compositing, and will-change layer
promotion were each ruled out during the investigation.

commit.message:
fix(announcements): sync viewer context after account changes

The announcement carousel kept the server-rendered list after client-side
login, logout, account switching, or profile changes, so notices could
show the wrong audience until a full page reload.

Re-fetch the visible announcements from the public API whenever the
account viewer signature changes, coalesce rapid changes, and compare
announcement content signatures so same-token HTML updates (for example
nickname templates) are applied. The stable first screen still makes no
extra HTTP request.

Refresh the SSO authorize page on account context changes and drop the
profile-wide router.refresh() now that each server-rendered surface has
an owner for targeted updates.

commit.message:
fix(next): keep query values out of localhost normalization

NextURL normalized the first localhost-like literal of the whole URL string,
so percent-encoded query values containing 127.0.0.1 were rewritten too.
With the production base host (0.0.0.0) the rewrite landed on redirect_uri,
and loopback SSO callbacks were rejected with invalid-object-structure.

Limit the replacement to the part before the first ?/# so host normalization
is unchanged. Covers the CJS/ESM dist sources and the webpack production
runtime bundle that app routes load, plus a plan doc with the cause, the
evidence and the maintenance constraints.
